findings.classification: Decompilation-informed TypeScript/JavaScript browser reimplementation, not matching console build or observed WASM
findings.codeGate: No overall grant identified in complete tree/selected documentation and implementation; game-derived expression and copied noclip sources need mapped origins/terms.
findings.dependencyGate: Selected fflate and gl-matrix MIT notices separately read. Lock resolves gl-matrix 3.4.4 while actual external import map loads 3.4.3; both notices recorded, no full bundle closure.
findings.contentGate: Stage/model/texture/common/background loaders and optional ZIP/local packs do not supply a full independent CC0 game-content pack; no external pack fetched.
findings.browserGate: Actual WebGL2/HTML/esbuild source exists; gameplay/persistence/stop/silent startup untested. Audio creates/resumes context with nonzero defaults.
findings.decision: Blocked on project/inherited grant and full independent content before integration; no build or live player run.

findings.dependencyGate: Original-era CodeWarrior compiler and console runtime/source tooling need their own terms; no binary acquired.
findings.contentGate: Reconstructed program/data does not establish independently authored complete game content.
findings.browserGate: Console matching target only; no reproduced matching result or native browser build.

findings.classification: PC executable-analysis/x86-to-C decompilation-derived reimplementation with desktop/Dreamcast source ports
findings.codeGate: Current custom no-sale licence is restrictive, supersedes older search-label assumption; from-scratch/no-original-code statement remains maintainer claim, no clean-room certificate.
findings.dependencyGate: SDL2/OpenGL/mixer/BearSSL/miniupnpc stack lacks exact selected runtime closure.
findings.contentGate: Requires original world/model/texture/path/audio data; supporting platform icons and pre-split replay announcer WAVs are not automatically independent/cleared content.
findings.browserGate: A Makefile comment mentions absent Makefile.emscripten; no game browser target found in tree or built.
findings.decision: Ineligible under present permissive-code criterion; independently authored graphics would not remove no-sale code restriction.

findings.classification: Android GLES2/SDL adaptation of same Sonic R title
findings.codeGate: Root and nested game notices retain custom no-sale licence.
findings.dependencyGate: Vendored SDL2 and exact SDL_mixer gitlink zlib-style notices read separately. Android disables FLAC/MOD/MP3/MIDI/Opus/Vorbis/WavPack, enables WAVE. Rust/JNI/launcher/other dependency closure unverified.
findings.contentGate: Original retail data required; no full independent content pack.
findings.browserGate: Android native target and SDL library Emscripten files do not establish a browser game; no game Web target observed.
findings.decision: Ineligible, duplicate game lead rather than new title.

findings.dependencyGate: Modified agbcc/luvdis/transmuter gitlinks recorded but not fully audited; original SDK-related music-player code needs separate rights.
findings.contentGate: Original baserom verified by setup and used for extraction/generated assembly/data; full independent assets/world/text/audio absent.

findings.classification: Same-title GBA reconstruction with contributor MIT declaration
findings.codeGate: MIT notice verified for declared contributor rights, inherited original game/SDK rights remain unclosed.
findings.dependencyGate: gbagfx and bin2c MIT-style tool notices separately verified; tool permission is not permission for extracted data/game.
findings.contentGate: Original ROM and extraction required; no full independently authored replacement content/provenance.

catalogDeduplication: None of the three audited game identities is present; Sonic R ports and Klonoa reconstructions each counted as one lead. Additional WebMonkeyBall modes not independently accepted.
